# vantage_tag (Resource)

Manages whether a tag key is preferred and/or hidden in the Vantage UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_tag" "environment" {
  key       = "environment"
  preferred = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The tag key to manage.

### Optional

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the tag key is hidden from the Vantage UI.
- `preferred` (Boolean) Whether the tag key is marked as preferred in the Vantage UI.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The tag key, used as the resource ID.
